note: The cleanest core fit in this batch and the only call in it that met every stated criterion. He is 28, working in AI consultancy with international travel and relocating to the US within the month; the $6,000 landed with no price resistance at all ('That sounds good to me') and the only friction was moving funds between currencies. Health is the neglected domain rather than a crisis — he trains five times a week and has done for years, but has never touched nutrition ('my nutrition has been a big issue, which I've never got around to a full program') and under-eats protein by roughly half. He is explicitly good-to-great: 'pretty much treading water... I still feel like there's a lot of fat around my body.' And he is emphatically not deconditioned. Worth pairing with the Jean-Philippe Rifaat assessment from the same batch: both are affluent, fit and product-convinced, and the one that closed is the one whose health was actually neglected. Neglected_health may be the criterion that predicts buying, not income.
